ACTION MEMO
  PARKLANDS COMMITTEE
  MARCH 10, 2014

Council Chambers  Monday
City Hall  March 10, 2014
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  7:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on
all appropriate items on Tuesday, March 25, 2014.

  & Wade

None

None

OLD BUSINESS

None

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, March 25, 2014.

  Director  SR-L
 NEW BUSINESS

A JOINT SESSION OF CITY COUNCIL AND PARKLANDS COMMITTEE:

1.  Review of Draft Parklands Use Policy

The City Council directed staff to modify the language and include provisions to
address the concerns of the Parklands Committee and residents for future
applications, administration and enforcement of the policy. The Policy is returning
to the City Council for further modification.

RECESS/RECONVENE

2.  Landscape repair to the Via Valmonte/Via Gorrion triangle median

Staff is directed to plant a California pepper tree to replace the tree that was
removed.

ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM THE COMMITTEE/STAFF

3.  Update on current projects

Action: Reviewed and filed.

4.  Update on previous applications

Action: Reviewed and filed.

ADJOURNMENT

Adjourned to April 14, 2014

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, March 25, 2014.

  Director  SR-L
